# Fish scales -- PLA, nozzle 205C, bed 60C, M221 S100

**Not yet print-tested.** Generated by `ideas_test.mjs fish-scales`; no library function exists for this texture.

Each scale: anchor puddle (Z 0.2->0.5, e 0.2) -> strand ramps +X over length L up to the tip height (e/d 0.05, F300) -> 500ms dwell -> retract -> 0.8mm dry pull to snap the tail -> lift. Scales point +X and each row is printed from its +X end, so later scales lie on the bases of earlier ones. "Overlap clearance" is how far the new strand runs above the one beneath (aim >= 0.4mm, one strand thickness).

Calibration line: `freeformSolid` x=120-180, y=70, printed first. Part fan on (`M106 S255`) after it, off at the end. Textures occupy x 19-60, y 24-66. `verifyLayout` (3mm min gap): ok=true, 0 warnings.

| id | position (x0, y0) | parameters | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| F1 | 19.0, 24.0 | L 4, tip 1mm, pitch 5, 8 scales | single tongues, no overlap -- baseline |
| F2 | 19.0, 32.0 | L 4, tip 1.5mm, pitch 5, 8 scales | steeper, higher tip, no overlap |
| F3 | 19.0, 40.0 | L 4, tip 1.3mm, pitch 2, 12 scales, overlap clearance 0.40mm | overlapping tiles, half-length pitch |
| F4 | 19.0, 48.0 | L 5, tip 1.7mm, pitch 2, 12 scales, overlap clearance 0.48mm | longer overlapping tiles |
| F5 | 19.0, 59.0 | 4 rows, 1.5mm apart, L 4, tip 1.3, pitch 2 | staggered 2D patch (4 rows x 10), the fish-skin field |

**What to look for**: Stroke each row toward +X (with the grain) and toward -X (against it): is there a clear difference? Do the tips stay raised or droop flat? In F3/F4/F5, did the overlapping strands fuse into a sheet or stay separate tiles? Did the dry pull leave clean tips or strings?

Totals: 2789 G-code lines, 83 retractions, 39.3 mm commanded filament.
